import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

urls = [
    "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=artificial+intelligence+AI+2026&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en",
    "https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/feed/",
    "https://the-decoder.com/feed/",
]

all_items = []

for url in urls:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; RSSBot/1.0)"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        # Strip namespaces for easy parsing
        raw_clean = re.sub(r' xmlns[^"]*"[^"]*"', '', raw)
        raw_clean = re.sub(r'<\?xml[^>]*\?>', '', raw_clean)
        root = ET.fromstring(raw_clean)
        channel = root.find('channel')
        if channel is None:
            channel = root
        items = channel.findall('item')
        for item in items[:8]:
            title = item.findtext('title', '').strip()
            link = item.findtext('link', '').strip()
            pub = item.findtext('pubDate', '').strip()
            desc_raw = item.findtext('description', '') or ''
            desc = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', desc_raw).strip()[:400]
            source_el = item.find('source')
            source = source_el.text if source_el is not None else url.split('/')[2]
            all_items.append({
                "title": title,
                "link": link,
                "pub": pub,
                "desc": desc,
                "source": source
            })
        print(f"[OK] {url} -> {len(items)} items")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERR] {url}: {e}")

print("\n===== AI NEWS ITEMS =====\n")
for i, item in enumerate(all_items, 1):
    print(f"[{i}] {item['title']}")
    print(f"    Source: {item['source']} | Date: {item['pub']}")
    print(f"    Link: {item['link']}")
    print(f"    Desc: {item['desc'][:300]}")
    print()
